zh-CN.name: 鼠标聚光
zh-CN.description: 光晕位置跟随指针，用局部亮度变化反馈鼠标所在位置。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 为卡片添加半径 {radius_px}px、颜色 {color}、透明度 {opacity} 的指针聚光，灯光跟随时间常数 {follow_ms}ms（0 直接跟随）；悬停抬升 {lift_px}px，抬升过渡 {duration_ms}ms。不拦截点击；触摸与减少动态效果时使用静态状态。

en.name: Cursor Spotlight
en.description: A pointer-tracked radial glow makes the hovered region visible.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Use a pointer-tracked radial glow with radius {radius_px}px, color {color}, opacity {opacity} and following time constant {follow_ms}ms (0 follows directly). Lift the card by {lift_px}px on hover over {duration_ms}ms. Do not intercept clicks. Use a static state on touch and reduced motion.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
